intervention: SEBI suspends new positions in Chana contracts
notes: SEBI PR 25/2021; no new Chana contract and no new positions in running contracts; only squaring-up permitted.

intervention: SEBI suspends new positions in Mustard Seed contracts
notes: SEBI PR 29/2021; applies to Mustard Seed contracts. No new contract or new position; only squaring-up permitted.

intervention: Central stock limits imposed on edible oils and oilseeds
notes: Official PIB retrospective confirms the 2021 stock-limit order was effective from 08.10.2021; important same-date confounder for mustard/oilseeds.

intervention: Import duties cut on crude palm, soybean and sunflower oils
notes: BCD on crude palm/soybean/sunflower oil cut from 2.5% to nil; AIDC reduced to 7.5% for CPO and 5% for crude soybean/sunflower oil; effective 14.10.2021.

intervention: SEBI directs suspension of agricultural derivative contracts for one year
notes: Directions issued 19.12.2021; SEBI PR 36/2021 released 20.12.2021. Covers paddy (non-basmati), wheat, chana, mustard complex, soybean complex, CPO and moong; applicable to 20.12.2022.

intervention: AIDC on Crude Palm Oil reduced from 7.5% to 5%
notes: Effective 12.02.2022; government stated the measure was intended to check domestic edible-oil prices.

intervention: Wheat export policy changed from Free to Prohibited
notes: DGFT order dated 13.05.2022 restricted wheat exports, subject to specified transitional and government-to-government exceptions.

intervention: Duty-free TRQ announced for crude soybean and sunflower oil
notes: Original Public Notice 10/2015-20 dated 24.05.2022 provided TRQs of 20 lakh MT each for crude soybean and crude sunflower oil; subsequent notices modified allocation details.

intervention: Export policy for wheat flour, maida and semolina changed from Free to Prohibited
notes: DGFT Notification 30/2015-20 dated 27.08.2022 covers wheat/meslin flour (atta), maida, semolina and wholemeal/resultant atta, with specified government-permission exceptions.

intervention: Broken-rice export prohibition and 20% export duty on specified non-basmati rice
notes: DGFT Notification 31/2015-20 dated 08.09.2022 changed broken-rice exports from Free to Prohibited with effect from 09.09.2022; 20% duty applied to specified other non-basmati rice categories.

intervention: SEBI suspension extension 1: through 20 December 2023
notes: SEBI PR 38/2022; extended the seven-commodity suspension for one further year to 20.12.2023.

intervention: Government approves 30 LMT wheat sale under OMSS(D)
notes: FCI was directed to offload 30 LMT from central-pool stocks through e-auctions and other channels to moderate wheat and atta prices.

intervention: Stock limits imposed on tur and urad
notes: Specified Foodstuffs amendment effective 02.06.2023; initially applicable through 31.10.2023 and subsequently extended/revised.

intervention: Stock limits imposed on wheat through 31 March 2024
notes: Specified Foodstuffs amendment effective immediately on 12.06.2023 for traders/wholesalers, retailers, big-chain retailers and processors; limits were revised subsequently.

intervention: Export of non-basmati white rice prohibited
notes: Export policy changed from Free with 20% export duty to Prohibited with immediate effect; parboiled and basmati rice were not covered by this change.

intervention: SEBI suspension extension 2: through 20 December 2024
notes: SEBI PR 25/2023; extended the suspension for one further year to 20.12.2024.

intervention: Stock limits imposed on tur and chana through 30 September 2024
notes: Order effective 21.06.2024 initially included Kabuli chana. S.O. 2718(E), dated 11.07.2024, subsequently excluded Kabuli chana from the stock-limit provision.

intervention: New wheat stock limits imposed through 31 March 2025
notes: Specified Foodstuffs amendment effective 24.06.2024. Limits were subsequently revised on 09.09.2024, 11.12.2024 and 20.02.2025.

intervention: Basic customs duty raised on crude and refined edible oils
notes: Government announced BCD on crude edible oils raised from 0% to 20% and basic duty on refined edible oils raised to 32.5%; material reversal of the 2021-22 import-duty reductions.

intervention: SEBI suspension extension 3: through 31 January 2025
notes: SEBI PR 37/2024 dated 18.12.2024; extended the seven-commodity suspension to 31.01.2025.

intervention: SEBI suspension extension 4: through 31 March 2025
notes: SEBI PR 07/2025; extended the suspension from 31.01.2025 to 31.03.2025.

intervention: Broken-rice export prohibition lifted
notes: DGFT Notification 61/2024-25 changed export policy for broken rice from Prohibited to Free with immediate effect.

intervention: SEBI suspension extension 5: through 31 March 2026
notes: SEBI PR 16/2025; extended the suspension to 31.03.2026. This removes the previously assumed January-to-March 2026 gap.

intervention: Wheat stock limits imposed through 31 March 2026
notes: Specified Foodstuffs (Amendment) Order, 2025 issued 27.05.2025; PIB release published 29.05.2025. Limits applied in all States/UTs through 31.03.2026 unless withdrawn earlier.

intervention: Central government withdraws the May-2025 wheat stock-limit order
notes: Official PIB release dated 05.02.2026 states the wheat stock-limit order dated 27.05.2025 was withdrawn following improved availability; weekly stock declarations continued.

intervention: SEBI suspension extension 6: through 31 March 2027
notes: SEBI PR 21/2026; continuation follows directly from PR 16/2025, which had already extended the suspension through 31.03.2026.
